concept.description: Labels object storage client methods (GCS, AWS S3, Aliyun OSS) as :OutboundCall and :SideEffectCall.
concept.cypher: MATCH (lt:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE lt.fqn IN ['com.google.cloud.storage.Storage', 'software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.S3Client', 'com.aliyun.oss.OSS', 'com.aliyun.oss.OSSClient', 'com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3'] AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) <> '<init>' AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) <> '<clinit>' SET m:OutboundCall:SideEffectCall RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS Methods
